verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Meta publishes per-family model cards (Llama 2–4) linked from the canonical GitHub repo and referenced in the llama.com FAQ, so a model card for the flagship exists and is discoverable. However, no evidence pack item shows the actual content of a flagship model card (training approach, detailed eval benchmarks, intended-use statement), and a separate probe found llama.com's developer docs pages gated behind an SSO login wall, raising doubt about frictionless public access to the full documentation surface. Missing for 10: direct excerpts of evaluation results/training methodology from the flagship model card itself, and confirmation the model card page (not just docs/overview) is publicly accessible without login.
